answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our economy runs multi-agent auditing over the network graph. Nodes stake tokens to tend a validation garden, where auditors inspect topological cut verifications. If a sudden gale of forged identities attempts partition, correlated fraudulent votes trigger stake slashing. Because minimal cut capacity requires stake scaling superlinearly with cluster size, attacker cost hits a zenith, rendering Sybil expansion unprofitable.
